import csv
with open(CATALOG_CSV) as f:
    cat=list(csv.DictReader(f))
targets=[x for x in cat if x['point_class']=='Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor']
ts={x['timeseries_id']:x['point_uri'] for x in targets}

best=None
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for x in csv.DictReader(f):
        if x['timeseries_id'] in ts and x['timestamp'] in ('2018-04-20T15:00:00','2018-04-20 15:00:00'):
            v=float(x['value'])
            if best is None or v>best[1]:
                best=(x['timeseries_id'],v)
print(best, ts[best[0]])
name=ts[best[0]].split('#')[-1].split('.')[0]
print(name)
